title: Natural cable-knit sweaters
summary: Bounded first-party catalog/product review included the requested merchant list except Bottega, plus ordinary retailers and department stores. Included listings have exact S evidence, natural main fabric, current displayed price and selected-color galleries. Discovery is not exhaustive: J.Crew CV666 had verified cashmere and price but incomplete S evidence; COS and A.P.C. cable crew-necks were reviewed but not promoted as zip-neck matches. Unlisted merchants are not claimed to have no qualifying stock.
